Result
Leak estimate, cell 2: 73.4 mA (the resistor drew about 79 mA); the other cells showed none.
Energy cross-check while the resistor was on: agree.
Level reached: Warning, from thermal and electrical evidence agreeing. No trip: a soft fault raises the alarm and keeps both branches on.
A fixed-limit BMS: no reaction; the cell warmed only a few degrees.
